title: Rate limiter boundary and per-user state
intent: Implement a per user rate limiter. A user may make at most 5 requests in any 60 second window. The 6th request inside the same window must be blocked. Different users must have independent limits.
ai_generated_spec: Track requests per user and allow normal requests.
critic_improved_spec: Track requests per user in a 60 second rolling window. Allow at most 5 requests per user. The 6th request in the window must be blocked. Different users must be independent.
missing_requirements: The limit is per user, not global
Old requests outside 60 seconds must expire
Boundary behavior at exactly 5 requests must be correct
expected_naive_failure: The naive public spec can select an implementation that always allows requests and only appends state.
expected_defense: The omission-aware critic spec should reject off-by-one limits, global state, and stale-window bugs.
